tbesh_html:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ch.15.18; also called Aziel at 1Ch.15.20;
Another name of ya.a.zi.el (יַעֲזִיאֵל "Jaaziel" H3268)
§ Aziel = "whom God comforts"
a Levite; also 'Jaaziel'

strongs_1890.derivation: from H5756 (עוּז) and H410 (אֵל); strengthened of God;
